scripts.desktop: cd desktop && npm run tauri dev
scripts.dev: start cmd /k "cd mobile && npx expo start" && npm run backend
scripts.dev:desktop: start cmd /k "cd desktop && npm run tauri dev" && npm run backend
scripts.dev:mobile: start cmd /k "npm run backend" && cd mobile && npx expo start
scripts.dev:all: start cmd /k "cd desktop && npm run tauri dev" && start cmd /k "cd mobile && npx expo start" && npm run backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../desktop && npm install && cd ../mobile && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
